question: What is the population of Delhi? Report the figure from the 2011 Census and the most recent estimate, noting any differences between sources.

analyst.question: What is the population of Delhi? Report the figure from the 2011 Census and the most recent estimate, noting any differences between sources.
analyst.plan:
QUERIES:
- "Delhi population 2011 Census"
- "Delhi population estimate 2023"
- "Delhi population 2022 provisional estimate"
- "Delhi NCT population latest official estimate"

PLAN:
- Find the exact 2011 Census population figure for the National Capital Territory of Delhi from the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner of India.
- Identify the most recent population estimate for Delhi (preferably 2022 or 2023) from reliable sources such as the Government of Delhi's Directorate of Economics and Statistics, the United Nations World Urbanization Prospects, or the World Bank.
- Note any discrepancies between the Census figure and the estimate, and verify the estimate by cross‑checking at least two independent sources (e.g., a government report and an international database).

claims.text: - The 2011 Census of India recorded the population of the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi as **16,787,941** persons.
This figure is also reported by the Census 2011.co.in district list for Delhi.
- A different CEIC dataset, which cites the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, lists the 2011 Census population for “Delhi: Delhi” as **16,368,899** persons.
The discrepancy likely reflects different geographic delimitations (e.g., Delhi district/core city versus the full NCT).

- The most recent official estimate available is the projection for **1 July 2023** from the Technical Group of the National Commission on Population, which puts Delhi’s population at **21,490,000** (21.49 million).

analyst.summary:
**  
- The 2011 Census of India recorded the population of the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi as **16,787,941** persons【https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delhi】. This figure is also reported by the Census 2011.co.in district list for Delhi【https://www.census2011.co.in/census/state/districtlist/delhi.html】.  
- A different CEIC dataset, which cites the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, lists the 2011 Census population for “Delhi: Delhi” as **16,368,899** persons【https://www.ceicdata.com/en/india/census-population-by-towns-and-urban-agglomerations-nct-of-delhi/census-population-delhi-delhi】. The discrepancy likely reflects different geographic delimitations (e.g., Delhi district/core city versus the full NCT).  
- The most recent official estimate available is the projection for **1 July 2023** from the Technical Group of the National Commission on Population, which puts Delhi’s population at **21,490,000** (21.49 million)【https://statisticstimes.com/demographics/india/delhi-population.php】.
